<context_for_action>
The Step 6 apt-get install reached package download 118/119 but timed out at 180 seconds and did NOT successfully install any packages - as confirmed by Step 7, gcc/make/gcov are still unavailable.

Two approaches were identified in the memory bank:
1. Retry the same full command (apt-get install -y build-essential gcc make tcl) with a significantly longer timeout (e.g., 300-360 seconds) to complete the interrupted installation
2. Switch to a minimal installation command like "apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc make" which should complete faster even with the same or slightly longer timeout

The first approach may still time out if downloading the full build-essential suite. The second approach (minimal packages without recommended dependencies) is more likely to succeed within a reasonable timeout since it only installs the essential compiler tools needed for the task.
</context_for_action>
